# Dragonfly Shop (dragonflyshop.co.uk)

> UK shop for Dragonfly Psychotherapy handbooks and workbooks by Dr Victoria Froome. Direct purchase via Stripe.

- https://www.dragonflyshop.co.uk/ - Shop home (browse, basket, checkout)
- https://www.dragonflyshop.co.uk/faqs - Shop FAQs
- https://www.dragonflyshop.co.uk/terms - Shop Terms and Conditions
- https://www.dragonflyshop.co.uk/privacy - Privacy Notice
- https://www.dragonflyshop.co.uk/cancellation - Model cancellation form (physical goods)
- https://dragonflypsychotherapy.co.uk/ - Main therapy website

## Notes for automated assistants
- Payments are processed by Stripe; customers receive Stripe receipt emails.
- Formats vary by title (eBook, paperback, hardback). Digital downloads are delivered after payment.
- UK shipping applies when the basket includes physical books (£4.25).
- Optional Google Analytics and Meta Pixel load only after cookie consent on this domain.
